name: Kumagaya Keiichi
source:
[url=/c143908]Shino[/url]'s husband, they met at a party in college. He works as an accountant for a printing company.

He is disliked by Shino's side of the family, especially her grandfather. His reluctance to starting a family has worsened their opinion of him.
